title: Evans Park
subtitle: Mill Creek Dam Replacement
summary: Two concepts for Evans Park on Mill Creek that test the dam question both ways: one removes the dam and returns the creek to a wetland corridor with fields, skate, splash, and crossings along a loop; the other keeps the dam and draws a plaza, splash pad, and courts up to the water. Rendered plans and perspectives by Matthew Reindl, UC DAAP MLA.

sections.heading: Brief
sections.body: Water infrastructure treated as public space. Concept one removes the dam: Mill Creek returned to a wetland corridor, with fields, skate and splash, and crossings along the loop. Concept two keeps the existing dam and expands recreation around it: a plaza on the impoundment, a splash pad, and courts drawn up to the water. Both carry the full program — soccer field, ball diamond, basketball, skate, splash, playground — and reuse the existing building.
